provenance.statement: Adapted from an authenticated copy of the accepted independent study-001 auditor, which was itself derived without producer source. The study-002 changes were derived only from the supplied study-002 specification, frozen configuration, output formats and binary record schema. No study-001 key, random tape, block, trajectory, record layout, count or estimand is used. Study-001 key texts are reconstructed only by the --kat-only key-disjointness check, which never generates a draw.
authorities: fixtures.json, PCONV-FIXTURES-1 (supplied text; list of fixture behaviours only, never expected values)

passes.statement: Began the bounded source-only adaptation from the authenticated study-001 auditor seed. Edited nine of the eleven files, then the account session limit was reached (CLI exit 1). It ran nothing and produced no scientific outcome. README.md and AUDITOR_NOT_RUN.json still held study-001 text. Supervisor disposition: TERMINAL_SESSION_LIMIT_PARTIAL_SOURCE_PRESERVED; resume once from the authenticated partial tree without restarting from baseline.
passes.changed_files_basis: The disposition records nine changed files. This list is the nine files other than README.md and AUDITOR_NOT_RUN.json, which still held study-001 text; it is inferred, not taken from a diff.

passes.statement: Inspected the nine CLAUDE-022 files for completeness and cross-file consistency. Checked: record offsets and struct formats against binary_records.json; cell index, HALF law and probe rule; the shared permutation's orientation and Lemire retries; the coordinate schemas; N1/N2/C1; the seven block numerators and the 19 estimate records; file sizes and counts; and that each of the five gate corruptions maps to the first discrepancy each verifier would report. No defect was found that required a code change. One diagnostic wording was changed ('survivor lineage' to 'survivor order'). README.md and AUDITOR_NOT_RUN.json were rewritten for study 002, removing the study-001 text, counts, paths and 22-estimate descriptions.
